provenance: Manual visual transcription of all 14 source slides, cross-checked with PPTX image/hyperlink relationships. All 14 fixed equipment expressions and the playground area were independently confirmed in the Google Form editor. Basketball's accidental accepted string 'Correct Answer' is excluded. The original Form assigns no static answer key to equipment-total and remaining-grass fields; the app calculates those from the three selected rectangles plus the custom block.

slides.title: Design Your Playground!
slides.description: Given the length and width in term of expressions, students will find the perimeter and area of different rectangles by distributive property and skills of simplifying expressions.

paragraphs: Hello folks! The school building manager has a wild idea: he wants to transform our schoolyard into a temporary playground wonderland for the holiday season. And guess what? He’s on the hunt for he most epic playground plan from our class!
Hold on! He needs to interview you first. The next 6 slides are the interview questions. He only hires the person who gets correct answers!
Done? Let’s put the answers here!
Next up, the boss wants to offer you an advantage: how about your very own block in this playground?
slides.linkNote: No external answer link in PPTX relationships; text is flattened into background.

steps: Step 1: Google any object/equipment that you want to put in the playground.
Step 2: Copy and paste the picture of it in the green box. Make sure it is inside the box.
Step 4: What is the perimeter of this block?
slides.areaPrompt: What is the area of this block?
slides.userAdaptation: Split into unnamed image-choice/name page and perimeter/area page. Replace Google/copy-paste with choosing and dragging from a 5–10 image tray; use original dimensions.

slides.title: Are you ready to build your own playground?
slides.description: You will put any 3 equipments plus your own equipment in the playground. Then, you will calculate the remaining area of the playground.

paragraphs: Copy and paste any 3 equipments into the next slide.
Then, post the picture of your own equipment in the next slide too!
slides.userAdaptation: Merge with slide13 into builder, top70% scene and bottom30% six-equipment tray; own custom equipment carried automatically.
Regenerate20–30 degree flatter-angle pixel lawn background. Carry arrangement into final page.

slides.description: Congratulations on reaching the final stage of the interview process. To your right, you will find the exact measurements of the playground. Your task is to calculate the area that remains uncovered, as this will help you determine how much of the playground needs to be covered with grass.
